title: The 5 Shortest Days in the Solar System, Ranked (Earth Barely Makes It)

scenes.text: Earth's day is 24 hours. Four planets spin faster, and one finishes in under ten.

scenes.label: Earth · 24 hours
scenes.text: Number five: Earth. Twenty-four hours, and that's the slowest spin on this list. Our day is a very long one.

scenes.label: Uranus · 17.2 hours
scenes.text: Number four: Uranus. About seventeen hours, spinning on its side like a barrel rolling around the Sun.

scenes.label: Neptune · 16.1 hours
scenes.text: Number three: Neptune. Sixteen hours to turn once, with the fastest winds in the solar system raging around it.

scenes.label: Saturn · 10.7 hours
scenes.text: Number two: Saturn. About ten hours and forty minutes, spinning so fast that the planet bulges at its middle.

scenes.label: Jupiter · 9.9 hours
scenes.text: Number one: Jupiter. Under ten hours for a full turn, even though it is more than eleven times wider than Earth.

description:
The five planets with the shortest days, ranked by the time they take to rotate once.
Jupiter, bigger than everything else combined, spins in under ten hours.
Which planet would you least like to live on?
first_comment: Did you expect Earth to make the list? Which space record should we rank next?
